references.text: The same principle that the priest shall declare the person unclean when the rash spreads on the skin
Parallel text describing the same procedure: if the rash spreads on the skin, the priest shall declare the person unclean
The same expression is used regarding the spreading of the rash and the priest's declaration of uncleanness
The same Hebrew root פָּשָׂה is used for spreading, here applied to leprosy in garments
The same principle regarding the spreading of leprosy, here applied to houses, with a declaration of uncleanness
